title: T4.1: Rewrite session-start hook — replace python3-based hook with story session-start call; under 20 lines; no python3 dependency; update cli-reference.md and workflow-patterns.md

text:
Acceptance: plugin/claude-code/hooks/session-start.sh rewritten to call story session-start (single CLI invocation, no python3); outputs JSON result directly; falls back to {} if story binary not found or command fails. Hook under 20 lines. No python3 dependency. Completes within 5-second hook timeout. plugin/claude-code/references/cli-reference.md documents story session-start. plugin/claude-code/references/workflow-patterns.md has no MCP references.
Files: plugin/claude-code/hooks/session-start.sh, plugin/claude-code/references/cli-reference.md, plugin/claude-code/references/workflow-patterns.md
